buddyLabel: {name}, your calendar buddy. Tap to hear {name}.
oneMoment: One moment! I'll tell you about this page as soon as it is ready.
noModule: I'm here to help you around your dashboard! Use the side menu to open a section and tap me there, and I'll tell you what it is.

welcome.tour: {hello} {school} I'm {buddy}, your calendar buddy. Tap Next and I'll show you around!
welcome.plain: {hello} {school} I'm {buddy}, your learning assistant. I'm here to help you explore your dashboard. Let's get started!

tour.hi: Hi! I'm {buddy}, your school buddy. Tap Next and I'll show you around!
tour.hiName: Hi {name}! I'm {buddy}, your school buddy. Tap Next and I'll show you around!
tour.calendar: This is your calendar, where all your classes and activities will appear. Click on an item to complete your coursework or join a class.
tour.live: Your class is live right now! Tap the green Join class button to go in.
tour.liveName: Your {name} class is live right now! Tap the green Join class button to go in.
tour.mini: This little calendar shows the whole month. A dot under a day means something is planned.
tour.views: Tap Today, Week or Month to see your plans in different ways.
tour.prevnext: Click on the arrows to view your plan for different days.
tour.clues: Color clues tell you what each box means. Tap a clue and I'll explain it!
tour.side: Use the side menu to book classes, see your teacher, join clubs and more. Hold and drag a button to move your favorites to the top!
tour.inbox: This is your inbox. Check here regularly for emails and other communications from your school.
tour.look: Tap the palette button to pick your favorite color, night mode, letters and text size!
tour.getApp: Download our app for a better experience!
tour.lms: Click here to go to your Learning Management System (LMS). This is where you learn, complete your assignments, take quizzes, and appear for exams.
tour.profile: Click here to go to your profile. Keep your personal details up to date, share more about yourself with the school, and change your password whenever needed.
tour.msg: Need help? Tap the green Talk to us button to chat with us!
tour.announcements: This is the announcements section. The school shares updates about events, activities, clubs, and holidays here. Don't miss out!
tour.news: Check here for the latest developments and updates in education.
tour.diary: This is your School Diary, where you can find important updates about your calendar and coursework from your teachers or the school.
tour.hero: This is your dashboard. It shows today's date, the time and the weather, and your next class. When a class is live, tap Join class to go in!
tour.goal: This is Today's Goal. Your classes, activities and assignments for today are listed here, and the ring fills up as you finish them!
tour.performance: This is My Performance. See your average, the date you want to finish by and how far along you are. Tap Set my goals to choose your own goals!
tour.assignments: This is My Assignments. The assignments due today and tomorrow are here, and a red card tells you if any are overdue. Tap Start to begin one!
tour.msgBalanced: Need help? Tap the Talk to us button to chat with us!

modules.home: This is your dashboard. Here you can see today's classes, your calendar and everything planned for you. Tap a day to see its plan!
modules.syllabus_assigned_teacher: These are your courses! Tap See course calendar to see every lesson and when it is due.
modules.student_attendance_overview: This is your Attendance section. Here you can check your attendance and see which classes you attended or missed.
modules.student_transcript: Tap the dots button to see your transcript.
modules.student_handbook: This book tells you all about your school!
modules.student_login_details: Here you can see every time you logged in!
modules.academic_year_extention: Tap a course to see how you can extend it.
modules.student_video_library: Watch your lessons in order, one by one!
modules.my_certificates: Need a certificate? Tap Request a certificate and the school will make it for you.
modules.student_progress_report: This is your My Performance section. Here’s how you’re doing in every course!
modules.progress_detail: Tap View to open a full report for that week!
modules.my_profile: This page is all about you! Keep your details up to date.
modules.fee_details: This is your Fee Details section. Here you can see your payments and what is still due.
modules.re_enrollment: This is the re-enrollment dashboard, click on the available options to continue your learning journey
modules.batch_student_examination_sheet: This is your Exam Sheet. Here you can see your exam marks.
modules.inbox: This is your Inbox. Read school messages here, or tap Write a message to talk to your teacher.
modules.inbox_compose: This is your Inbox. Read school messages here, or tap Write a message to talk to your teacher.
modules.student_addon: Want more classes? Pick a plan, then ask a grown-up to buy it!
modules.cart: Want more classes? Pick a plan, then ask a grown-up to buy it!

clubFallback: Pick a club from the menu and join the fun!

clubTips.spanish_club: ¡Hola! In the Spanish Club you learn Spanish words, songs and stories with friends. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.french_club: Bonjour! The French Club is where you speak French, play word games and learn about France. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.german_club: Hallo! In the German Club you learn German words and fun facts about Germany. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.english_club: The English Club is for reading, speaking and writing in English with friends. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.chinese_club: Ni hao! In the Chinese Club you learn Chinese words, characters and festivals. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.team_building_club: In the Team Building Club you play games and solve challenges together as a team. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.cultural_exchange_club: The Cultural Exchange Club lets you meet friends from other countries and share your culture. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.leadership_skills_club: The Leadership Skills Club helps you lead, plan and help your team. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.debate_club: In the Debate Club you share your ideas, listen to others and learn to argue kindly. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.drama_expression_club: The Drama and Expression Club is for acting, role play and showing your feelings on stage. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.public_speaking_club: The Public Speaking Club helps you speak in front of others with confidence. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.student_council_club: The Student Council is where students share ideas and help make school better. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_debate_club: The Debate Club, IDOS, is where you practise speeches and debates like a diplomat. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_book_club: The Book Club, ILS, is for reading books together and talking about them. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_art_club: The Art Club, Viva De Lunaria, is for drawing, painting and making art with friends. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_stem_club: The STEM Club, Aurelian, is for science, tech, engineering and maths projects. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_gaming_club: The Gaming Club, Link Club, is where you play and talk about games with friends. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_law_club: The Law Club, Lex Orbis, lets you explore rules, rights and mock trials. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_global_exchange_club: The Global Exchange Club, Nexus, connects you with students around the world. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_wellness_club: The Wellness Club, Radiant Mind, is about staying calm, healthy and happy. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_newsletter_club: The Newsletter, The Horizons, is where you write and share school news and stories. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.the_entrepreneurship_club: The Entrepreneurship Club helps you turn your ideas into a small business plan. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.focus_reaction_training_club: The Focus and Reaction Training Club trains your eyes, hands and quick thinking. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.skill_development_club: The Skill Development Club helps you get better at your favourite games step by step. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.team_communication_club: In the Team Communication Club you learn to talk and plan with your team while you play. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.online_tournaments_club: The Online Tournaments Club lets you play in online matches and tournaments. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.strategy_games_club: The Strategy Games Club is for thinking ahead and planning smart moves in games. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.competitive_gaming: The Competitive Gaming Club is for playing as a team and getting ready for matches. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.global_competitions_club: The Global Competitions Club lets you take part in gaming contests with students worldwide. Tap Register Now to join!
clubTips.game_strategy_analysis_club: In the Game Strategy and Analysis Club you study games and learn why moves win. Tap Register Now to join!

classesTour.plan: This is Today's Plan. All your classes and activities for the day are here. Tap one to see more about it.
classesTour.planFree: This is Today's Plan. There are no classes or activities today, so enjoy your free day! Your classes and activities show up here on the days you have them.
classesTour.planHoliday: This is Today's Plan. Today is a holiday, {name}, so there are no classes or activities. Enjoy your day! Your classes and activities show up here on the days you have them.
classesTour.mini: This little calendar shows the whole month. A dot under a day means something is planned. Tap a day to open it.
classesTour.courses: These are your courses. Tap a course to show or hide its classes in your plan.
